name: Volta
owner: A fictional supplements and sport shop: the brand of a sales demo
idea: A training box turned into a brand: carbon, steel and chalk, with volt as the only signal light.
place: An online demo store, based in Mar del Plata

display.role: Headlines in capitals, tall and tight

text.sample: 24 g of protein per scoop, with batch and expiry date in plain sight.

grid: The plate is six modules a side; the symbol sits on the middle four.
The chalk stroke aims at the tip of the bolt: that is where the V closes.
The name stands as tall as the V, one and a half modules away.

alt.logo: Volta logo: the plate with the V and its bolt, beside the name
alt.secondary: Stacked version: the plate on top and the name below, on its lane
alt.submark: Volta symbol: a V that closes with a bolt
alt.patterns: Three patterns: bolts with one switched on, graph paper and the box floor with tape
alt.post: Sample post: Charge your best self, the scoreboard at 24 g and the tub
alt.story: Sample story: how to load up, in three scoreboard readings
alt.poster: Sample poster: the giant symbol on carbon, with the name and the demo tape
alt.print: Sample Club Volta coupon, as a ticket with its stub
alt.object: Ionic Whey tub in 3D: volt lid, house label and how to use it

source: Symbol, colours, typefaces and the LED scoreboard come from the demo's repo. The grid, the patterns, the pieces and the tub were drawn for this board, with sample copy.
